summary: Service intake deposits and handover payments can name the receiving money account, like other Order payments, so the collected balance posts Dr money account / Cr 2200 once (Finance roadmap F3.8.05). The dashboard service job Take payment and Hand over steps and the mobile service payment sheet and Order Record payment sheet and the dashboard and mobile intake forms now choose the account the same way checkout does. Roles, permissions and assistant rollout are unchanged.
noAssistantImpact: No assistant tool, prompt authority, capability declaration or write is added. services.handoff gains an optional payment.moneyAccountId and services.createAndConfirmIntake an optional initialPaymentMoneyAccountId; the planned assistant service capabilities and assistant job cards do not send them and keep their existing behaviour and rollout.

docs.note: Follow-ups, 27 October 2026: service handover receiving account.

evidence.result: 1 pass, 15 assertions on the Neon development database with an isolated QA Tenant: a cash account refuses a bank transfer and rolls back both the handoff and the intake; the chosen bank account receives the handoff balance and the intake deposit once each, retries replay, a changed account on replay is refused, cash stays 0.
db, api and mobile tsc clean; dashboard tsc has no errors in the changed service-work file.
